desc: Key Applications: Virtualization, Software-defined Storage, AI Inference and Machine Learning, Cloud Computing, Enterprise Server, High-Performance Computing (HPC)
Dual Socket AMD EPYC™ 9006 SP7 Series Processors up to 512 Cores
Supports up to 4 PCIe 6.0 x16 slots
Flexible networking with 1 AIOM slot (OCP 3.0 SFF/TSFF compliant)
Modular front drive bay design supporting up to 16 U.2/E3.S or 12 E1.S hot-swappable NVMe drives
Front PCIe slot available on select configurations
Optional rear hot-swappable M.2 drive bays (hot-swappable functionality only available when configured as RAID)
Dual Redundant Titanium Level power supplies (Power supply full redundancy based on configuration and application load)
